logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the compounds was determined using a shake-flask method [23]. A mixture of 50 mL water and 50 mL of 1-octanol were shaken together for 24 h to saturation of both phases. 5 μM solution of the all compounds were prepared in the aqueous phase. Then 3 mL of each of these stock solutions were added to 3 mL of the 1-octanol phase. The biphasic solutions were shaken overnight and then centrifuged to separate the two phases. After that, the aqueous layer was carefully separated and the concentration in the aqueous phase (before and after mixing with 1-octanol) were determined using UV–Vis spectrophotometry (D = [Sample]org/[Sample]aq.
